## Changes since v2.3.3

- Added support for the Logitech G515 Rapid TKL keyboard and fixed per-key Logitech device layouts, including the fix for [MineLights #12](https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights/issues/12).
- Updated RGB.NET to its Development revision `97888172944a92af50c9da7afdf56920332a02f9`, bringing its additional device support, including the latest SteelSeries and Razer definitions.
- Added the Razer Kraken Kitty V2 Pro headset (vendor ID `1532`, product ID `0554`).
- Kept the test releases' self-contained build without ReadyToRun, reducing the executable size compared with the first test build.
- Made builds reproducible from the pinned RGB.NET source instead of relying on locally modified NuGet packages.
